author: TeIq
content:
**Scope.** design.md §10 ML classifier integration question. Bluesky has in-house classifiers; the right integration is gRPC with classifier output flowing as another signal into the pattern engine — never as an autonomous actor (a human always actions).

**v1 connection points.**
- Pattern engine (#17/#18/#19) is built to accept additional `Observation` sources.
- This issue wires up a gRPC `ClassifierClient` that fetches classifications on inbound events and emits `Observation { kind: ClassifierSignal { model, label, confidence } }`.

**Scope sketch (refine in design doc).**
- gRPC service definition (`polaris.classifier.v1.Classifier`).
- Sample classifier types: NSFW image, harassment text, spam.
- Per-classifier trust weights (similar to upstream-labeler trust weights from #32).
- Failure modes: classifier slow / unreachable / disagreeing — never block ingest, attach signal when available.

**References.**
- design.md §10 (ML classifier integration shape — explicitly worth a separate design conversation).
- `tonic` crate for gRPC (https://docs.rs/tonic) — verify current.

**Pre-implementation.**
- `/design polaris-ml-classifier-integration` doc.
- Discussion with Bluesky on the wire shape if first-party integration is in scope.

**Rust-quality.**
- gRPC service is a `pub trait ClassifierClient`; tests use an in-memory stub.
- Per-call timeout + circuit breaker (`tower::ServiceExt::timeout` + a circuit-breaker layer).
- Never let classifier latency block firehose ingest — fire-and-forget pattern with bounded outstanding requests.

**Testing.**
- Classifier-down: ingest continues with no `ClassifierSignal` observations.
- Classifier-disagrees: signals from multiple classifiers attached, dashboard surfaces the disagreement.
